synthesis: DEV-2342 W1. After PR 328, scout:record-check-ins matches server-side in one CH statement per kit and PHP memory is O(matches). Duration is still blocked because every Scout reader filters clarity.sc_positions with lower(kit_mapping) against ORDER BY (kit_mapping, timestamp_utc). Cloud EXPLAIN 2026-08-13: 3355/33096 granules vs 20/33096 exact-case. Prod 2026-08-17 skipped kits with CH 159 at ~30s. Locked design (Jeffrey Cobb, DEV-2342 comment 38238): ADD PROJECTION proj_kit_mapping_lc ORDER BY (lower(kit_mapping), timestamp_utc) then off-peak MATERIALIZE (~6.5 GiB). chlocal owns the DDL (DEV-2177). Platform stays SELECT-only until Cloud apply, then schema dump + wiki. PHP keeps lower(kit_mapping). Schedule stays commented (W4).
